attributes.action: Time to stop the sale of fireworks to the public
attributes.additional_details: Every year from September all the way through November there is fireworks going off nightly every single night which is causing animal distress let alone some people are throwing fireworks at cars going past which is very dangerous and could cause a crash and kill someone everything about fireworks in the hands of certain people is dangerous this will continue to happen unless they are banned from public sale permanently
attributes.background: I want government to stop sale of fireworks to public from September all way past November fireworks are going off causing animals stress also the new thing is if anyone dies or injured no matter what circumstances are fireworks start fireworks need to be banned only used at organised events

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Outlaw fireworks for the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/766448
